beats.text: In Iraq, natural resource rents make up 43.4% of GDP. In the USA, just 1.3%.
That gives Iraq 33 times the resource reliance of the USA.
These rents sum up oil, natural gas, coal, mineral, and forest rents.
Across the globe, the median country sits at just 1.7%.
Libya leads all countries at 61%, while Japan dips to 0.05%.
How much of your nation's economy comes from natural resources?
